name: hrbvhd-pairing-poll
goal: A transient relay poll failure leaves the pending browser pairing available for approval within the 20 second window.

title: Inspect sibling pairing clients and retry loops for the same failure.

evidence: The Google Device Linking spec defines transient poll recovery on the same pending request and the original 20-second deadline.
The connect method test ended before polling; the account Devices browser fixture always approved the first poll. Both existing cases now exercise a one-off relay failure.
